message: Hey Bill, how’s the new ad campaign coming along?
We just launched it yesterday. I’m hoping it gets a good response.
I’ll keep an eye out for it. Where’s it running?
It’s on the highway near downtown. You can’t miss it!
Bill, I was driving earlier and noticed something interesting.
Just saw your ad on the highway! It looks fantastic.
Thanks! That’s great to hear. We put a lot of effort into it.
